scope:
Archive qualification reports with verified source/build provenance.

Refuses replacement, verifies referenced source/program artifacts and scrubs the
current local account prefix. Does not turn a negative report into a pass.

report.scope: Check true-length softmax patches in a fixed zero-padded attention schedule.

contract.scope:
Compile packet commands whose BF16 intermediate values stay on the NPU.

Host code packs weights and metadata only. A static initialization map rejects
reads of unwritten arena locations before compilation or device execution.
This is a research command stream, outside the ONNX graph compiler.
